title: A breathing timer with cues that suit you
description: A choice of voice, sound or vibration, with a clear pause and setup beforehand.

blocks.text: Watching a small animation is not always convenient. The listener needs a distinct cue that suits the place and the time of the session.
Let people try the ways guidance can arrive, save the settings they choose and control the timer without constantly looking at the phone.
Do not pass an arbitrary rhythm off as a treatment program or a universal training plan. Interface settings and medical advice are different jobs.
